Measured by compositing 237@179/255 over TODAY's under-glyph bytes (band paint does not move when the in-box label leaves): 027_Shadow_Spread 4/203 px (raw spread 173 → 52: one platform paints there, another not), 037_Transform_Rotate 5/237 (max 4), 082_Outline_Dashed 15/203 (raw 173 → 52: dash phase differs), 098_Neumorphic_Light 155/225 (raw up to 37 → 11). 024/032 drop to ≤1 (green); the other 13 have 0. This is the defect class review C39 removed from v2. Options: keep ±1 and accept 4 red stems post-refresh; raise MASK_TOL (cannot save 027/082 at spread 52); or drop (iii) to (i)-only per design §4(c) — a one-branch edit in checkTriplet. Recommendation: the third.

CI consequence: the file is in the `node --test tools/visual/*.test.mjs` glob (ci.yml:101, smoke.sh:217) and is red on HEAD by design — the PR cannot be green unless the UPDATE_BASELINE refresh of all 390 PNGs lands in the SAME PR (intended, but must be sequenced).

Post-refresh (ii) depends only on the glyph bytes: today's rows 0..15 are already byte-identical ×3 on all 111 band-identical stems, so any (ii) red after the refresh is a platform colour/geometry defect, not pre-existing band noise.

P3 additionally asserts BlockLabel.kt contains no `@Composable` and no `fun BlockLabelPlaceholder` (the composable is deleted, not just un-called); P1 additionally pins `_`→space (`harnessLabelRects("A_B",390) == BlockLabel.rects("A B")` and != rects("A_B"), since the atlas has a `_` glyph).

ComponentRenderer's nameless-leaf branch renders `EmptyView()` (usedWidth + BlockLabel removed, branch kept so real-text leaves reach PlaceholderLabel); C27 comment fixed in ScreenshotCaptureView.swift. Five mutations executed and restored byte-exact (cmp-verified): all red as designed. Focused Catalyst run: 53 tests, 0 failures. Harness app built for iphonesimulator with provision-devices.sh's exact invocation: BUILD SUCCEEDED. designDeviations: BlockLabelLayout/BlockLabel made public with an explicit public init as the brief instructs, although the r3 harness-contract correction's optional corollary notes they no longer need a cross-module consumer (the chrome lives in the runtime). Harmless; done as instructed.

CaptureCanvasMirror: instead of view-builders that the test decorates afterwards, `flowCanvasView(_:withLabelChrome:)` / `outOfFlowCanvasView(_:withLabelChrome:)` take a flag (default false → byte-identical to the pre-(A) chains for BlendGroupCompositingTests) that inserts the overlay at the harness's EXACT mounting point (after `.background`, before the environment nodes), so the chrome test measures the harness's mounting position rather than an overlay appended after the environment nodes. `flowCanvas` / `outOfFlowCanvas` kept as raster conveniences; `rgb(_:_:_:)` probe added.

HarnessLabelChrome exposes the predicate as a pure static `showsLabel(_:wptCaptureMode:backdropPass:)` and the text rule as `labelText(for:)` (unit-pinnable without a render surface, the suppressesNamePlaceholder pattern); body behaviour is exactly the design's `if … { BlockLabel } else { EmptyView }`.

Added a once-only `PropertyTracker.logOnce` for the zero-glyph case (frame < 22 px) in `BlockLabel.shownGlyphs` — house rule 5 (no silent fallthrough; Android's twin logs the same case); not in the design.

The design listed WPTCaptureModeTests as unchanged, but its `testNamelessEmptyGlyphsVanishOnlyInWptMode` asserted `off > 0` (runtime paints label ink with the flag OFF) and is red by design after (A); re-targeted and renamed to `testRuntimePaintsNoNameLabelInEitherMode` (both arms == 0), which also pins 'the label must no longer be rendered by the runtimes' (mutation M5 proves it). Likewise EmptyFlexContainerTests.testChildlessFlexPlaceholderSitsAtTop lost its subject and was re-targeted on a real-`text` container (ink = any non-fill, non-canvas pixel in the box rows).

Executed two mutations beyond the brief's three: dropping the `.sampling` guard (design §4 names it) and M5 (restoring BlockLabel in the leaf branch). M1 was executed on the mirror's chain, not on CaptureCanvas.swift (not in the Catalyst target) — as design §4 anticipates.

Blend pin 2: the child-centre probe asserts EXACT equality with (0,26,46) (the raster measurement the brief asked for) while the pixel counts keep tol 1; the box-fill probe (24,8,11) at (20,20) is added.

The HarnessLabelChromeRasterTests mutation record notes per-effect signatures only as observed incidentally under M5 (clip-path kept 91/178 lit px; multiply/opacity darken theirs below the lit threshold), per the r3 correction that the band pins do not observe them.
ComponentRenderer.swift: also reworded the stale 'renders via BlockLabel above' comment in the real-text leaf branch (not named in the design).
